steps.labelEn: Sign in with email and password

deviations.zh: 登录或注册页提示邮箱地址无效或过长

deviations.zh: 邮箱步骤点“继续”后提示无法检查该邮箱地址

deviations.zh: 邮箱或密码框下出现红色 “Failed to fetch”，中文页面也是英文

deviations.en: Sign-in says 'Email or password is incorrect.'
deviations.zh: 登录提示“邮箱或密码不正确”

deviations.en: I signed up but cannot sign in; it only says the password is incorrect
deviations.zh: 注册后一直无法登录，只提示密码不正确

deviations.zh: 密码超过 30 个字符，登录时输入不完整

deviations.en: The password box shows 'Please enter your password.' or 'Password must contain at least 8 characters.'
deviations.zh: 密码框提示请输入密码或密码至少 8 个字符

deviations.zh: 明明有账号，输入邮箱后却进入了注册页

deviations.en: My account is disabled but email sign-in only says the password is wrong, or sends me through sign-up to a Check your email page
deviations.zh: 账号被禁用，但邮箱登录只提示密码错误，或绕到“请检查邮箱”页面

deviations.en: The sign-in form already has my email and password filled in
deviations.zh: 登录页已经自动填好了我的邮箱和密码

deviations.en: I do not remember which email I signed up with, so I cannot sign in
deviations.zh: 不记得注册时用的是哪个邮箱，登录不了

steps.labelEn: Sign in or sign up with Google or WeChat
steps.labelZh: 用 Google 或微信登录/注册

deviations.zh: 用 Google 登录后回到登录页，提示 Google 没有提供已验证的邮箱地址

deviations.en: I signed in with Google and my courses, plan or learning records are gone
deviations.zh: 用 Google 登录后，课程、订阅或学习记录都不见了

deviations.en: After my first Google sign-in my name is the first part of my email address
deviations.zh: 第一次用 Google 登录后，姓名显示成邮箱 @ 前面的部分

deviations.en: Google or WeChat sign-in ends on the sign-in page with 'The provider sign-in could not be completed'
deviations.zh: Google 或微信登录后回到登录页，提示第三方登录没有完成

deviations.en: Sign-in page says my sign-in request has expired or is invalid, always in English
deviations.zh: 登录页提示登录请求已过期或无效，而且总是英文

deviations.en: WeChat sign-in says it was cancelled
deviations.zh: 微信登录提示已取消

deviations.en: WeChat sign-in says my WeChat identity has conflicting account links
deviations.zh: 微信登录提示微信身份关联存在冲突，请联系支持团队

deviations.en: Google or WeChat sign-in says this Learning Guide account has been disabled
deviations.zh: 用 Google 或微信登录提示该账号已被禁用

deviations.en: Google sign-in says an account already uses this email and asks me to sign in with email and password first
deviations.zh: 用 Google 登录提示该邮箱已有账号，要求先用邮箱和密码登录

deviations.en: Pressing the Google or WeChat icon shows a plain page of JSON text instead of the provider
deviations.zh: 点 Google 或微信图标后出现一页纯文字 JSON，而不是登录页

deviations.en: There is no Google or WeChat icon on the sign-in or sign-up page
deviations.zh: 登录或注册页上没有 Google 或微信图标

deviations.en: After pressing Google or WeChat the provider page never loads or shows an error of its own
deviations.zh: 点 Google 或微信后，第三方页面一直打不开或自己报错

steps.labelEn: Bind an email to my WeChat account

deviations.zh: 打开绑定链接后提示链接无效或已过期

deviations.zh: 打开了绑定链接，“请检查邮箱”页面却没有跳转

deviations.zh: 确认绑定后提示“邮箱已验证，请在此设备重新使用微信登录”

deviations.en: The Send / Resend verification email button is greyed out with a wait message
deviations.zh: “发送/重新发送验证邮件”按钮是灰色的，并提示需要等待

deviations.en: The binding page says this account cannot be connected
deviations.zh: 绑定页提示暂时无法关联此账号

deviations.en: Confirming the binding says this WeChat account already has activity and I must contact support
deviations.zh: 确认绑定时提示此微信账号已有使用记录，请联系支持合并账号

deviations.en: After binding, WeChat shows my OLD account (old name, old plan) and the account I just made with WeChat is gone
deviations.zh: 绑定后微信登录进入的是原来的旧账号，刚用微信新建的账号不见了

deviations.en: The binding page says it could not send the binding email
deviations.zh: 绑定页提示暂时无法发送绑定邮件

deviations.en: The binding page says my session has expired and to sign in with WeChat again
deviations.zh: 绑定页提示登录会话已过期，请重新使用微信登录

deviations.en: After WeChat sign-in I keep landing on the bind email page and cannot reach My Learning or the sign-in page
deviations.zh: 微信登录后总是停在绑定邮箱页，进不了我的学习

steps.labelZh: 在个人设置里绑定 Google

deviations.en: I think someone else is using my account

deviations.zh: 收到自称 Learning Guide 的邮件或消息，要求提供银行卡信息

deviations.zh: 找不到“退出登录”按钮

deviations.en: I pressed Sign out but I still look signed in, or I am signed out only on this device
deviations.zh: 点了退出登录，但仍显示已登录，或只在这台设备退出

deviations.en: A course I saw earlier is not under the tab I picked, or the tab shows no courses.
deviations.zh: 之前看到的课程不在所选分类标签下，或该标签下没有课程。

deviations.zh: 打开课程链接后显示“课程不可用”，看不到课程。

deviations.zh: 课程页顶部的“开始试看”按钮打开的是登录页或 404 页，而不是课时。

deviations.zh: 课程页只显示“课程已下架”，没有课程大纲和方案。

deviations.en: The right-hand card shows 'This plan is not currently available.' instead of a price.
deviations.zh: 右侧卡片显示“此方案暂不可用。”，没有价格。

deviations.en: The Preview button on lesson 1 is greyed out, and no other lesson has a button.
deviations.zh: 第一课的“试看”按钮是灰色的，其他课时没有按钮。

deviations.en: As a visitor I press Preview and land on the sign-in page instead of the free lesson.
deviations.zh: 未登录时点击“试看”，进入的是登录页，而不是免费课时。

deviations.en: A preview link shows a 404 page.
deviations.zh: 试看链接打开的是 404 页面。

deviations.zh: 免费试看到此结束，出现“免费试看已结束”提示和“喜欢这门课程吗？”弹窗；后面的文本内容被锁定。

deviations.zh: 试看期间 AI 导师、探索和理解测验入口是灰色的。

deviations.en: The preview shows 'Your progress could not be saved. Please try again.'
deviations.zh: 试看页提示“学习进度保存失败，请重试。”

deviations.en: The page says 'You have Everything' and offers no plan to buy.
deviations.zh: 页面显示“你已拥有 Everything”，没有可购买的方案。

deviations.en: A plan shows 'Already subscribed' and cannot be selected, or Continue says I already have an active subscription covering it.
deviations.zh: 某个方案显示“已订阅”且无法选择，或点击继续时提示已有覆盖该方案的有效订阅。

deviations.en: A plan is shown as unavailable, or Continue says the plan is temporarily unavailable.
deviations.zh: 某个方案显示不可用，或点击继续时提示该套餐暂时无法购买。

deviations.en: The plans page shows 'Subscription plans could not be loaded.' with a Try again button.
deviations.zh: 订阅方案页显示“订阅方案暂时无法加载。”和“重试”按钮。

deviations.en: After I pick a plan I am taken to the sign-in page.
deviations.zh: 选好方案后被带到登录页。

deviations.en: I cannot find a mobile-only plan on the plans page.
deviations.zh: 方案页找不到仅限手机的方案。

deviations.en: After I press the buy button on a plan, a red message appears and the confirmation window does not open.
deviations.zh: 点方案的购买按钮后出现红色提示，确认窗口没有打开。

deviations.zh: 在 Everything 或分类方案卡片上找不到“开始三天试用”。

deviations.zh: 开始试用失败：方案页用英文提示该方案不含试用，或确认窗口提示因试用已用过或已结束而无法继续。

deviations.en: Starting the trial says I already have an active subscription covering this plan.
deviations.zh: 开始试用时提示已有覆盖该方案的有效订阅。

deviations.en: The Continue button on 'Confirm your subscription' is greyed out, or checkout says I must tick every confirmation.
deviations.zh: “确认订阅”窗口里的“继续”按钮是灰色的，或提示须勾选全部确认项。

deviations.en: I am sent back to the plans page, or told the quote or checkout has expired.
deviations.zh: 被送回方案页，或提示报价或支付会话已过期。

deviations.en: Continue fails saying the checkout address does not match the website's configuration.
deviations.zh: 点击继续后提示当前支付来源地址与网站配置不一致。

deviations.en: After Continue the window says checkout could not be prepared, payment is unavailable, or the purchase cannot continue.
deviations.zh: 点击继续后提示无法准备结账、支付暂不可用，或无法继续此次购买。

deviations.en: After Continue (or another payment button) the window shows 'Failed to fetch' and I do not know whether I paid.
deviations.zh: 点“继续”（或其他付款按钮）后显示 “Failed to fetch”，不知道是否已付款。

deviations.en: I closed or cancelled the Stripe payment page. Am I subscribed, and how do I try again?
deviations.zh: 我关闭或取消了 Stripe 支付页面，是否已订阅？怎么重试？

deviations.en: My card was declined or an extra authentication step failed on the Stripe page.
deviations.zh: 我的银行卡在 Stripe 页面被拒或额外验证失败。

deviations.en: On the 'Local payment test' page the payment shows as failed or cancelled (demo mode only).
deviations.zh: 在“本地支付测试”页面，付款显示失败或已取消（仅演示模式）。

deviations.en: On the 'Local payment test' page pressing Complete payment, Simulate failure or Cancel payment shows an error.
deviations.zh: 在“本地支付测试”页面点“完成支付”“模拟失败”或“取消支付”后出现错误提示。

deviations.en: I have a discount or promotion code but there is nowhere to enter it.
deviations.zh: 我有优惠码，但找不到输入的地方。

deviations.en: I paid but my course is still locked, and My Subscription says I have not subscribed yet and shows 'Check payment status'.
deviations.zh: 我已付款但课程仍未解锁，“我的订阅”显示尚未订阅并出现“重新查询支付状态”。

deviations.en: My payment failed or was not completed and no plan appeared.
deviations.zh: 我的付款失败或未完成，没有出现任何订阅。

deviations.en: A page says 'Payment result unavailable'.
deviations.zh: 页面显示“无法获取支付结果”。

deviations.en: A payment I made is not in Payment history.
deviations.zh: 我付过的一笔款没有出现在付款记录里。

deviations.en: The Receipt column shows a dash instead of 'View receipt', or the receipt link shows an error.
deviations.zh: 收据一栏显示“—”而不是“查看收据”，或点开收据时报错。

deviations.en: I see a Paid row I did not expect.
deviations.zh: 付款记录里出现了我没有预期的“已付款”记录。

deviations.en: Payment history shows a Failed or Payment cancelled row next to a Paid row.
deviations.zh: 付款记录里“失败”或“支付已取消”的记录和“已付款”记录并排出现。

deviations.en: My Subscription shows 'Your subscriptions could not be loaded.' with a Try again button.
deviations.zh: “我的订阅”显示“暂时无法加载订阅，请重试。”和“重试”按钮。

deviations.en: A card in Past subscriptions says 'Subscription status unavailable' with 'Valid period' or 'Period not recorded'.
deviations.zh: 历史订阅中的一张卡片显示“暂时无法获取订阅状态”，有效期一栏为“有效期”或“未记录有效期”。

deviations.en: Payment history shows a 'Payment pending' row.
deviations.zh: 付款记录里出现“支付处理中”的记录。

deviations.en: 'View receipt' opens a page that only says the payment could not be verified.
deviations.zh: 点“查看收据”后打开的页面只显示“暂时无法核验付款，请重试。”

deviations.en: Opening My Learning lands on the sign-in page instead of my courses
deviations.zh: 打开“我的学习”却跳到登录页，看不到课程

deviations.en: I subscribed (or started a trial) but My Learning says I have not started any courses
deviations.zh: 已订阅（或开了试用），但“我的学习”显示还没开始学习任何课程

deviations.en: The card or the course page says Start / Course detail, not Resume Learning; did I lose my progress?

deviations.en: A course card says its learning progress could not be loaded
deviations.zh: 课程卡片提示无法加载学习进度

deviations.zh: 课程卡片按钮变成“查看订阅方案”，不能继续学习

deviations.zh: 课程卡片写“继续预览”，只能看一小段

deviations.zh: 直播间提示直播课无法连接

deviations.en: The room says this Live Session has ended
deviations.zh: 直播间提示这节直播课已结束

steps.labelEn: Chat and raise my hand in the room

deviations.en: The chat box is greyed out and says chat is available only while connected
deviations.zh: 聊天框是灰的，提示只有连接后才能聊天

deviations.en: My message shows Something went wrong with a Send button
deviations.zh: 我的消息下面提示出错，有“发送”按钮

deviations.en: I cannot see earlier messages after joining late or reloading
deviations.zh: 晚进入或刷新后看不到之前的聊天记录

deviations.en: I pressed Raise Hand but my hand did not show
deviations.zh: 我点了举手，但手没有显示

steps.labelEn: Ask the AI Tutor in the live room
steps.labelZh: 在直播间向 AI Tutor 提问

deviations.en: The AI Tutor button is greyed out and says it is offline for this course
deviations.zh: AI Tutor 按钮是灰的，提示本课程的 AI 导师未开放

deviations.en: There is no AI Tutor button; typing @AI Tutor gets no answer
deviations.zh: 没有 AI Tutor 按钮，输入 @AI Tutor 也没有回答

deviations.en: My question says it was not sent because I must wait for earlier answers
deviations.zh: 我的提问未发送，提示要等之前的问题回答完

deviations.en: My question says too many questions in a short time
deviations.zh: 我的提问未发送，提示提问太频繁

deviations.en: My question says AI Tutor is not available right now
deviations.zh: 我的提问未发送，提示 AI Tutor 现在不可用

deviations.en: My question says my place lapsed while the connection was down
deviations.zh: 我的提问未发送，提示连接中断期间位置已失效

deviations.en: My question says AI Tutor answers only while the Live Session is live
deviations.zh: 我的提问未发送，提示 AI Tutor 只在直播课进行中回答

deviations.en: My question was not sent for another reason (cannot do that, access, sign-in)
deviations.zh: 我的提问因其他原因未发送（无权操作、课程权限、登录）

deviations.en: My question says Waiting for AI Tutor with some questions ahead
deviations.zh: 我的提问显示“等待 AI Tutor 回答，前面还有 N 个”

deviations.en: The AI Tutor line changed to temporarily unavailable
deviations.zh: AI Tutor 的回答变成了“暂时不可用”

deviations.en: Everyone in the room can see my AI Tutor question and the answer
deviations.zh: 房间里所有人都能看到我向 AI Tutor 的提问和回答

deviations.en: I press Withdraw but AI Tutor has already started answering
deviations.zh: 我点“撤回”时，AI Tutor 已经开始回答了

deviations.en: The AI Tutor in the Live Session does not know what is on the shared screen
deviations.zh: 直播课里的 AI Tutor 不知道共享屏幕上的内容

steps.labelEn: Answer the AI Tutor's check question with my group
steps.labelZh: 和小组一起回答 AI Tutor 的理解检查问题

deviations.en: Leave Session says I have not left yet because the request did not go through
deviations.zh: 点离开后提示“你还没有离开：请求没有成功”

deviations.en: The dialog says leaving will end the Live Session
deviations.zh: 离开对话框提示我离开后直播课就会结束

deviations.en: I am the Host and I left; the session is still going
deviations.zh: 我是主持人，我离开了，直播课还在继续

deviations.en: I closed the page but I still count as in the session for a while
deviations.zh: 我关了页面，但在一段时间内仍被算作在直播课里

deviations.en: After leaving there is no Rejoin button
deviations.zh: 离开后没有“重新加入”按钮

steps.labelEn: The session ends and what stays afterwards
steps.labelZh: 直播课结束与结束之后

deviations.en: The Live Session says it has ended and I cannot join it
deviations.zh: 直播课显示已结束，我进不去

deviations.en: The Live Session ended while people were still talking or I lost connection
deviations.zh: 大家还在说话时直播课就结束了，或我断线后直播课结束了

deviations.en: It is past the planned end time but the session is still live
deviations.zh: 已经过了计划结束时间，直播课还在进行

deviations.en: My name is not in the attendees of the Completed session
deviations.zh: 已结束的直播课的参会名单里没有我

deviations.en: As the Host I cannot find a Leave button
deviations.zh: 我是主持人，找不到“退出学习小组”按钮

deviations.en: After leaving (and joining again) my Plan to Attend is gone
deviations.zh: 退出（再加入）之后，我计划参加的直播课都没了

deviations.en: Confirming Leave shows an error in the dialog
deviations.zh: 确认退出后对话框里出现错误提示

deviations.en: A member's group vanished and they see no reason
deviations.zh: 成员的小组消失了，看不到原因

deviations.en: As a member I cannot cancel the group
deviations.zh: 我是成员，没法取消小组

deviations.en: I cancelled the group and want it back
deviations.zh: 我取消了小组，想恢复

deviations.en: The group was cancelled while a Live Session was running and the room ended
deviations.zh: 小组被取消时直播课正在进行，房间被结束

deviations.en: I was charged after my three-day trial.
deviations.zh: 三天试用结束后被扣款了。

deviations.en: My trial stopped and the course is locked again.
deviations.zh: 试用结束后课程又被锁定了。

deviations.en: I got no reminder that my trial was about to end.
deviations.zh: 试用快结束时没有收到提醒。

deviations.en: My first payment after the trial failed and the card says 'Payment failed'.
deviations.zh: 试用后的首次付款失败，卡片显示“付款失败”。

deviations.en: The 'Upgrade to Everything' link or button is missing or greyed out, or the page says the upgrade is unavailable.
deviations.zh: “升级到 Everything”入口缺失或灰色，或页面提示无法升级。

deviations.en: The upgrade card says the upgrade price could not be loaded.
deviations.zh: 升级卡片提示暂时无法获取升级费用。

deviations.en: I am told an upgrade payment is in progress, and the Category card shows 'Pay now'.
deviations.zh: 提示升级付款正在处理中，分类卡片上出现“立即支付”。

deviations.en: I paid for the upgrade but Everything is not active yet, and the card still shows a Pay now link.
deviations.zh: 我已支付升级费用，但 Everything 还没有生效，卡片上仍显示“立即支付”链接。

deviations.en: I cannot move to a cheaper plan, switch between 6 and 12 months, or change device.
deviations.zh: 无法改成更便宜的方案、在 6 个月和 12 个月之间切换，或更换设备类型。

steps.labelEn: Renew and fix a failed payment

deviations.en: My card says 'Payment failed' with a 'Grace period until' date, or the plans page says 'Payment needs attention'.
deviations.zh: 订阅卡片显示“付款失败”和“宽限期结束日期”，或方案页提示“付款需要处理”。

deviations.en: I already paid, but the card still says Payment failed.
deviations.zh: 我已经付款，但卡片仍显示“付款失败”。

deviations.en: Selecting 'Pay now' shows 'Billing could not be opened.' or an English error.
deviations.zh: 点击“立即支付”后提示“无法打开账单管理。”或一条英文错误。

deviations.en: I cannot find a button to update my card.
deviations.zh: 找不到更新银行卡的按钮。

deviations.en: I was told I would get an email before each payment, but no email arrived.
deviations.zh: 页面说每次付款前会发邮件提醒，但我没有收到邮件。

deviations.en: Turning auto-renewal back on fails.
deviations.zh: 重新开启自动续费失败。

deviations.en: My card says 'Auto-renewal off' but I did not turn it off.
deviations.zh: 卡片显示“已取消自动续订”，但我没有关闭过。

deviations.en: I cannot see 'Cancel auto-renewal' because my card says Payment failed.
deviations.zh: 卡片显示“付款失败”，找不到“取消自动续订”。

deviations.en: The trial cancel window says my access remains, but the course locked straight away.
deviations.zh: 取消试用的弹窗说访问权限不受影响，但课程立刻被锁定了。

deviations.en: I cancelled my trial and cannot find a way to restore it.
deviations.zh: 取消试用后找不到恢复试用的入口。

deviations.en: After I cancelled auto-renewal my access is still active.
deviations.zh: 取消自动续订后，我仍然可以继续学习。

deviations.en: Cancelling fails with a message about the subscription or about confirming the change.
deviations.zh: 取消失败，提示订阅有问题或无法确认变更。

deviations.en: There is no refund button, and the plans and cancel windows say purchases cannot be refunded.
deviations.zh: 没有退款按钮，方案页和取消窗口都写着购买后不支持退款。

deviations.en: After a refund my order says Refunded and my plan ended.
deviations.zh: 退款后订单显示“已退款”，订阅也结束了。

deviations.en: My subscription shows Expired and my courses are locked.
deviations.zh: 订阅显示“已过期”，课程被锁定。

deviations.en: An expired subscription has no 'Turn on auto-renewal' button, or turning it on says it cannot be resumed.
deviations.zh: 已过期的订阅没有“开启自动续费”按钮，或开启时提示无法恢复。

deviations.en: I got no email or message when my subscription expired.
deviations.zh: 订阅到期时没有收到邮件或站内消息。

deviations.en: My Subscription says I have no current subscriptions, but my old plan is listed under Past subscriptions.
deviations.zh: “我的订阅”显示目前没有有效订阅，旧方案只出现在“历史订阅”里。

deviations.en: Saving Personal settings says 'Settings update failed.'
deviations.zh: 保存个人设置时提示“设置保存失败”

deviations.en: I pressed Save changes and cannot tell whether my settings were saved, or they look unchanged afterwards
deviations.zh: 点了“保存修改”，不确定是否保存成功，或保存后看起来没变

deviations.en: Save changes says 'Country is required.'
deviations.zh: 保存时提示“请选择国家或地区”

deviations.en: My country is not in the Country list
deviations.zh: 国家/地区列表里找不到我的国家

deviations.en: Saving says the name must be 50 characters or fewer
deviations.zh: 保存时提示姓名不能超过 50 个字符

deviations.en: Saving says the name must be 1-50 letters or numbers
deviations.zh: 保存时提示姓名只能是 1–50 个文字或数字

deviations.en: I saved a new name but the top right still shows my old name
deviations.zh: 保存了新姓名，右上角仍显示旧姓名

deviations.en: I cannot tick another Area of interest; the other options are greyed out
deviations.zh: 兴趣领域选不了更多，其余选项变灰

deviations.en: There is no way to upload a profile photo, only a letter in a circle (feature hidden)
deviations.zh: 找不到上传头像的入口，只有一个字母圆圈（入口被隐藏）

deviations.en: Use default fails with 'Image removal is temporarily unavailable'
deviations.zh: 点“使用默认头像”失败，提示图片暂时无法删除

deviations.en: I switched the site language with the EN / 中 link in the header, but it went back to the other language later
deviations.zh: 用顶部 EN / 中 切换了语言，之后又变回另一种语言

deviations.en: An email from Learning Guide is in a different language from the site I am using
deviations.zh: 收到的 Learning Guide 邮件语言和我正在用的网站语言不一致

deviations.en: I came back and the site is in English again.
deviations.zh: 我再次打开网站，又变回了英文。

deviations.en: A link without /en-GB or /zh-CN opens a 404 page.
deviations.zh: 没有 /en-GB 或 /zh-CN 前缀的链接会打开 404。

deviations.en: The Notification Center is empty or says notifications are not active
deviations.zh: 通知中心是空的，或提示通知功能尚未启用

deviations.en: The bell icon in the header does nothing and shows no unread number
deviations.zh: 顶部的铃铛点了没反应，也没有未读数字

deviations.en: I cannot find a setting to stop or choose Learning Guide emails (feature not built)
deviations.zh: 找不到停止或选择接收 Learning Guide 邮件的设置（功能未开发）

deviations.en: The cookie banner keeps coming back
deviations.zh: Cookie 提示条总是再次出现

deviations.en: A cookie box covers the bottom of the page and I cannot reach the button under it
deviations.zh: 页面底部被 Cookie 提示框挡住，点不到下面的按钮

deviations.en: I want to change my cookie choice but the banner is gone
deviations.zh: 想更改 Cookie 选择，但提示条已经没有了

deviations.en: The Privacy Policy or Terms of Service is short and does not answer my question
deviations.zh: 隐私政策或服务条款很简短，没有回答我的问题

deviations.en: I want to delete my account but there is no button (feature not built)
deviations.zh: 想注销账号，但没有任何入口（功能未开发）

deviations.en: I want a copy of the data you hold about me but there is no export or request button (feature not built)
deviations.zh: 想查看或导出平台保存的个人数据，但没有入口（功能未开发）

steps.labelEn: Find an answer in the Help Centre

deviations.en: I searched the Help Centre and no article matches.
deviations.zh: 我在帮助中心搜索，没有找到匹配的文章。

deviations.en: The Help Centre says articles are temporarily unavailable and shows only a few common answers.
deviations.zh: 帮助中心提示文章暂时无法加载，只显示几条常见解答。

deviations.en: I opened a Related FAQ link (or an old ?faq= link) and the article is not there.
deviations.zh: 我点了“相关问题”链接，但找不到那篇文章。

deviations.en: A topic (or the popular list) says there are no articles.
deviations.zh: 某个主题（或热门列表）显示还没有文章。

deviations.en: I cannot find the AI Support Assistant or a Contact form on the Help Centre page.
deviations.zh: 帮助中心页面里没有 AI 客服助手，也没有提交表单。

steps.labelZh: 向 AI 客服助手提问

deviations.en: The assistant says I have asked too many questions in the last hour.
deviations.zh: 助手提示我过去一小时提问太多。

deviations.en: The assistant says it cannot answer well, sometimes with a list of questions I might mean.
deviations.zh: 助手说这个问题还答不好，有时会列出“你可能想问”的几个问题。

deviations.en: The assistant says it could not reply just now.
deviations.zh: 助手说暂时无法回复。

deviations.en: The assistant shows 'Let’s get you to a person' with a Contact Support button.
deviations.zh: 助手显示“为你转接人工客服”和“联系客服”按钮。

deviations.en: The assistant asks 'Still need help?' with End chat and Contact Support buttons.
deviations.zh: 助手问“还需要帮忙吗？”，并给出结束对话和联系客服两个按钮。

deviations.en: The assistant says it cannot explain a point and will check with the support team.
deviations.zh: 助手说这一点没法在这里讲清楚，会转给客服确认。

deviations.en: My Helpful? Yes/No vote was not saved.
deviations.zh: 我点的“有帮助吗？”没有保存成功。

deviations.en: The assistant cannot check my order, payment or account.
deviations.zh: 助手无法查看我的订单、付款或账户。

deviations.en: The assistant shows a card that one of my enquiries is waiting for my reply.
deviations.zh: 助手显示一张卡片：我有一个工单在等我回复。

deviations.en: My earlier chat is gone in a new tab or browser.
deviations.zh: 我换了标签页或浏览器，之前的对话不见了。

deviations.en: The assistant shows no starter chips.
deviations.zh: 助手没有显示推荐问题。

steps.labelEn: End the chat and rate it

deviations.en: My chat says it has ended after I stopped typing.
deviations.zh: 我一段时间没操作，对话显示已结束。

deviations.en: I cannot find an End chat button.
deviations.zh: 我找不到“结束对话”按钮。

deviations.en: My rating of the chat was not saved.
deviations.zh: 我给对话打的分没有保存成功。

steps.labelZh: 联系客服（提交问题的表单）

deviations.en: Contact Support sent me to the sign-in page.
deviations.zh: 点“联系客服”后被带到了登录页。

deviations.en: I cannot sign in, so I cannot reach the enquiry form.
deviations.zh: 我登录不了，所以进不了提交问题的页面。

deviations.en: The form shows that my order could not be attached.
deviations.zh: 表单提示无法关联我的订单。

deviations.en: I left the page and my unsent enquiry is gone.
deviations.zh: 我离开页面后，没发出去的内容不见了。

deviations.en: The form says my Subject or Message is not valid (too long or empty).
deviations.zh: 表单提示主题或详细描述不符合要求（太长或为空）。

deviations.en: The form says my email is not valid.
deviations.zh: 表单提示邮箱地址无效。

deviations.en: After Submit the form says to check it and try again.
deviations.zh: 提交后提示请检查填写内容后重试。

deviations.en: My file was not added to the enquiry.
deviations.zh: 我的文件没有被添加到工单。

deviations.en: The form says I have sent a lot of requests in the last hour.
deviations.zh: 提示我一小时内提交的次数过多。

deviations.en: After Submit the form says my session has ended.
deviations.zh: 提交后提示登录已失效，需要重新登录。

deviations.en: After Submit the form says support is temporarily unavailable.
deviations.zh: 提交后提示客服系统暂时不可用。

deviations.en: After Submit the form says the order cannot be linked.
deviations.zh: 提交后提示无法关联这个订单。

deviations.en: After Submit the form says one of my files is not a supported type, although its name ends in .jpg, .png, .pdf, .docx or similar
deviations.zh: 提交后提示有文件的类型不受支持，但文件名明明是 .jpg、.png、.pdf、.docx 等

deviations.en: After Submit the form says each file must be 10 MB or smaller, although no single file was refused when I added it
deviations.zh: 提交后提示每个文件不能超过 10 MB，但添加文件时并没有提示

steps.labelZh: 查看系统给出的快速解答

deviations.en: The Submit button has been on Checking for a quick answer for a long time.
deviations.zh: 提交按钮一直显示“正在查找快速解答…”。

deviations.en: I clicked Yes, this solved my issue and no enquiry was sent.
deviations.zh: 我点了“是的，问题已解决”，但没有工单发出。

deviations.en: The question I picked did not show an answer.
deviations.zh: 我选的问题没有显示解答。

deviations.en: My rating of the suggested answer was not saved.
deviations.zh: 我给解答打的分没有保存成功。

deviations.en: No quick answer appeared and my enquiry was sent straight away.
deviations.zh: 没有出现快速解答，工单直接发出了。

steps.labelEn: Send a message from Contact us

deviations.en: The Contact us form says to check the required fields, email and consent box.
deviations.zh: “联系我们”表单提示请检查必填项、邮箱和同意选项。

deviations.en: The Contact us form says my message could not be submitted.
deviations.zh: “联系我们”提示留言提交失败。

deviations.en: The Contact us form says this submission has changed and asks me to submit again.
deviations.zh: “联系我们”提示本次提交内容已变更，请重新提交。

deviations.en: I sent a Contact us message and got no confirmation, number or reply.
deviations.zh: 我在“联系我们”留言后，没有收到确认、编号或回复。

deviations.en: My enquiries says support is temporarily unavailable.
deviations.zh: “我的工单”提示客服系统暂时不可用。

deviations.en: My enquiries says I have not contacted support yet.
deviations.zh: “我的工单”显示我还没联系过客服。

deviations.en: My enquiry still says Submitted.
deviations.zh: 我的工单一直显示“已提交”。

deviations.en: I sent an enquiry and have not had a reply.
deviations.zh: 我提交了工单，一直没收到回复。

deviations.en: Support replied but I got no email.
deviations.zh: 客服回复了，但我没收到邮件。

deviations.en: The page says this request was updated, please check again.
deviations.zh: 页面提示工单已更新，请重新查看。

deviations.en: Sending a reply says my session has ended.
deviations.zh: 发送回复时提示登录已失效。

deviations.en: Sending a reply says to check the form, or a file is too large, the wrong type or too many.
deviations.zh: 发送回复时提示请检查内容，或文件太大、类型不支持、数量过多。

deviations.en: Sending a reply says I have sent a lot of requests in the last hour.
deviations.zh: 发送回复时提示一小时内提交的次数过多。

deviations.en: The enquiry page says it could not be found (or shows a 404 page).
deviations.zh: 工单页面提示找不到这个工单（或出现 404 页面）。

deviations.en: The enquiry page says support is temporarily unavailable.
deviations.zh: 工单页面提示客服系统暂时不可用。

deviations.en: The enquiry has no reply box and says it is closed.
deviations.zh: 工单没有回复框，提示这个工单已结束。

deviations.en: Sending a follow-up says the 7-day window has passed.
deviations.zh: 追问时提示已超过 7 天追问期限。

deviations.en: The 'View or reply' link in the support email opens the sign-in page (or a 404 page after I sign in)
deviations.zh: 客服邮件里的“查看或回复”链接打开的是登录页（或登录后显示 404）

deviations.en: My enquiry says Awaiting your reply
deviations.zh: 我的工单显示“待你回复”

deviations.en: Support asked Is it solved? and I am not sure what to click.
deviations.zh: 客服问“问题解决了吗？”，我不知道该点哪个。

deviations.en: There is no Withdraw button on my enquiry.
deviations.zh: 我的工单上没有“撤回”按钮。

deviations.en: I withdrew an enquiry by mistake and cannot reopen it.
deviations.zh: 我误撤回了工单，没办法恢复。

deviations.en: I pressed My issue is solved by mistake.
deviations.zh: 我误点了“问题已解决”。

deviations.en: I cannot see the rating section on my enquiry.
deviations.zh: 我在工单里看不到评分区域。
